reason: The primitive hexagonal metric (a = 8.782281 A, c = 2.731546 A), cell volume, and Z = 1 are strongly supported by indexing, but exact structure recovery is not. The comparable-Rwp report supplies no score, and the trajectory never performed a full-profile Rietveld comparison. Instead, it imposed P3 with Zr at 1a and four independent general threefold orbits (12 coordinate variables) and optimized manually integrated line areas; even the best objective is 0.0596 and leaves conspicuous intensity errors, including weak or absent lines calculated much too strongly. The submitted alternatives are merely distinct, worse minima of the same P3 parameterization (0.0864 and 0.0946), not systematic tests of competing symmetries, framework topologies, or Co/Ge orderings. The selected model has broadly plausible distances, so it may capture aspects of the average framework, but plausibility and the cell fit do not establish its P3 symmetry, coordinates, or element ordering. Scientifically motivated higher-symmetry/split-site and ordering alternatives could materially improve the candidate set, so another solution attempt is warranted.
